clusters.description: Dana White on the Jim Rome show says Topuria is healed and ready, and the UFC is weighing a Gaethje rematch vs a Pimblett fight
Fan reactions online to Dana White hinting Topuria vs Pimblett could headline a numbered card without a title
clusters.doubt: It restates White's hint but the article's actual content is a roundup of fan tweets, so I treated it as a reaction rather than the same story.

clusters.description: Justin Gaethje's MightyCast interview with Demetrious Johnson: Topuria's footwork was easy to predict, and he won't fight again this year while he recovers
clusters.doubt: Both pieces quote the same Demetrious Johnson / MightyCast sit-down, but one covers the Topuria game plan and the other his retirement and injuries, so they read as different topics from one interview.

clusters.description: Dana White says there is a lot of money left on the table for Gaethje to make (i.e. he should not retire)
clusters.doubt: The body is almost entirely page navigation junk, so I cannot tell whether this quote comes from the same Jim Rome interview as 10-a or a different appearance.

clusters.description: Belal Muhammad says Topuria does not deserve an immediate Gaethje rematch and should fight Paddy Pimblett instead
Topuria, in a 1Win video, says he no longer ties his happiness to achieving goals and now lives in the present
clusters.doubt: The second half of the article recaps Dana White saying Topuria is ready, but the news it leads with is the 1Win quote.

clusters.description: Myllena Messias's manager responds after Tapology flags her recent bout as a fake fight (Topuria only appears in a sidebar link)
Alex Pereira says he will drop back to 205 to fight Paulo Costa if he does not get a heavyweight shot (does not concern Topuria)

uncertain_pairs.why: Both are built on Dana White's Jim Rome remark about Topuria vs Pimblett; 1066 just adds fan tweets on top, so it could be counted as the same story rather than a reaction.
Both quote Gaethje's MightyCast interview with Demetrious Johnson, but one is about Topuria's footwork and the other about retirement, so a reviewer might split them into two remarks.
White's 'money left on the table' comment about Gaethje may come from the same Jim Rome appearance where he discussed Topuria's return, but the scraped body is too broken to confirm.
1101 devotes its back half to Dana White confirming Topuria is ready, so it partly reports the same news as 10-a even though its lead is the 1Win mindset quote.
